release_notes:
Microsoft Store purchase unlock fix.

- Fixes a problem where buying the app from the Microsoft Store after the free trial ended did not always unlock it. The app now reliably recognizes a completed purchase: it re-checks your license automatically in the background after launch, so a purchase made in the Store app unlocks within about a minute without restarting.

- Once your purchase is confirmed it stays unlocked -- a brief hiccup talking to the Store can no longer re-lock a paying customer.

- The "I purchased -- refresh" button now tells you what happened (unlocked, no purchase found yet, or Store unavailable) instead of appearing to do nothing.

- Hardened the Store license check so it can't silently fail on some PCs.

If you are still locked out after purchasing: confirm the Microsoft Store is signed in with the same account you bought with, open Microsoft Store > Library > Get updates, then reopen the app.
